changelog:
privacy-scan 0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Scan any public web page for privacy and cookie-consent signals related to GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and ePrivacy.
- Identifies static-HTML signals: presence of trackers and consent tools, privacy-policy and Do-Not-Sell links, cookie attributes, and HTTPS.
- Provides honest disclaimers about the limitations of static HTML analysis—does not execute JavaScript or detect pre-consent tracking.
- Available via REST endpoints and as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0) for integration with agents.
- Free to use, privacy-first design, honors robots.txt, and has built-in SSRF and abuse protections.
summary: Scan any public web page for GDPR/CCPA/ePrivacy privacy & cookie-consent signals — honest about what static-HTML testing can and cannot catch
